sys_script_include.description: Deny-by-default masking layer. Tokenizes all sensitive values (names, emails, amounts, rules, order IDs) before any data is sent to an external LLM (OpenAI/Claude), and rehydrates the tokens in the response so output stays accurate. Includes a leak-detection guard that blocks a request if any real value survives masking. Not used for the in-boundary ServiceNow Now LLM.
sys_script_include.name: IncentIQDataMasker
